issues.where: whole frame across the hook window
issues.what: almost nothing changes across the hook: the loop arch, sunspot, horizon and camera framing look nearly the same from frame 0 to the last frame. The only changes are a slight flicker in the footpoint glow and small strand shifts, so nothing rewards staying past the first second
issues.fix: add a clear event inside the hook seconds, such as a visible camera push toward the sunspot, a flare brightening or the loop erupting, or the arch rising and snapping, so the last frame clearly differs from frame 0

issues.what: at phone-preview width in a 16:9 frame, the arch takes up only about a third of the width and its fine filaments become thin, busy lines. The darkest, emptiest area is the starfield, which fills the top 40% of the frame
issues.fix: frame tighter on the arch and sunspot, or use a vertical or square crop, so the loop fills more of the frame and reads as one bold shape at small size

issues.what: the granulation texture across the bottom is almost as bright and high-contrast as the arch, so it competes for attention and the subject's figure-ground separation is weaker at small size
issues.fix: darken or slightly defocus the foreground surface and the edges of the frame (a vignette) so the hot footpoints and the arch are clearly the brightest point of focus

issues.what: the sunspot is small and lower in contrast than the arch, so it reads as a dark smudge at phone size rather than a second focal point
issues.fix: enlarge it or add a stronger penumbra edge if it is meant to be part of the hook
